soundness_flags.label: ass:endpoint-pivotality and ass:uniform-endpoint-pivotality
soundness_flags.one_line: These load-bearing new assumptions are justified only by an informal appeal to diffuse distance fronts; no named realistic graph-rule class or even the supplied local-chord witness is shown to satisfy either modulus, so the exactness contribution remains an instrumental conditional result without established applicability.

soundness_flags.label: ass:bandwidth-tail and ass:uniform-bandwidth-tail
soundness_flags.one_line: Nonnegative shell summability plus pointwise bandwidth divergence already implies the pointwise tail condition, and its uniform counterparts imply the uniform tail condition by choosing a deterministic tail cutoff first.
